about.description: NAS100 is an index perpetual listed on MEXC, tracking Nasdaq-100 Index, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 200x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
